data.one_liner: Command-line tools for generating and linting bloc and cubit components.
data.what_it_does: Provides command-line tools to scaffold new bloc, cubit, hydrated_bloc, hydrated_cubit, replay_bloc, and replay_cubit components. It also includes an official bloc linter command to analyze source code.
use_when: You want to quickly scaffold new bloc or cubit files from templates
You want to enforce bloc-specific code quality and consistency rules via CLI linting
avoid_when: You are looking for runtime state management widgets or libraries
You manage your project workflow without using Dart global CLI tools
strengths: Automates the creation of boilerplate code for multiple bloc variants
data.setup_notes: Install globally using `dart pub global activate bloc_tools`.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate bloc_tools
bloc new bloc --name counter
bloc lint .
